session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend, Trading Range, Late Reversal Up'. Consecutive bear bars sell-the-close bear trend from the 4140 open to the 4118-4115 lows (07:00-09:00), a bull trap gap bar sell spike to 4135 (08:30), then an afternoon trading range with a minor lower low double bottom (09:55) and expanding triangle; bulls held a higher low major trend reversal at 12:00 and the strong breakout came after the day session close with colored swing boxes into a ~4135 close-ease from the session highs.
